purpose: Prepare a measurable demand program with optional paid and partnership work while preserving a zero-spend, no-send, no-launch, and no-account-mutation boundary.

objective_signals: The objective concerns qualified demand, a bounded paid experiment, or an evidence-based partnership hypothesis.
prerequisites: The offer, audience, qualification rule, human follow-up capacity, metric definitions, and zero-execution authority boundary are explicit.

nodes.objective: Bind one demand decision, offer, qualification rule, owner capacity, economics question, zero-spend boundary, non-goals, and stop rule.
Collect bounded evidence about the buying context, alternatives, channel constraints, partner fit, conversion assumptions, and proof gaps.
Bind baseline, qualified-demand metric, population, window, guardrails, data quality, incrementality boundary, and decision rule before any activation.

nodes.run_when: Activate only when a paid-channel hypothesis, conversion baseline, measurement contract, explicit human budget ceiling, and sensitive-audience review exist; output remains paused with zero spend.
nodes.objective: Specify a falsifiable paid-acquisition experiment with audience exclusions, creative matrix, economics, measurement, guardrails, and a human-only activation checklist without spending or changing an account.

nodes.run_when: Activate only for qualified inbound interest or a documented strategic hypothesis with mutual user value and a named human relationship owner.
nodes.objective: Prepare a bounded evidence packet covering partner criteria, mutual user value, fit, conflicts, risks, open questions, and human-owned next actions without contact enrichment or outreach.

nodes.run_when: Activate only when a validated B2B offer, buying context, qualification definition, measurable funnel, and named human follow-up capacity are evidenced.
nodes.objective: Prepare a demand-readiness package with offer, qualification, handoff capacity, campaign structure, tracking, risks, non-goals, and explicit no-send, zero-spend, no-launch status.

Assemble one supported acquisition-readiness package with audience, offer, proof, channel sequence, owners, measurement, risks, rollback, non-goals, and explicit no-send, zero-spend, no-launch status.
Review the exact acquisition-readiness package for evidence, qualification, measurement, privacy, sensitive audiences, relationship authority, budget boundaries, and no-execution compliance.
